title: [Day 02] Session format and event types
text:
@cursor Part 4 of 5 for issue #2: Factory and guards.

Read AGENTS.md (sections Parts, QA and bug fixes, Commits), .cursor/rules (including 90-lessons.mdc) and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md first. Read the whole issue #2, then do ONLY Part 4.

Work test-first: first a test commit `test(shared): add event factory, type guard and format version (#2)` with tests and stubs, then the implementation commit.

Prompt: Add `FORMAT_VERSION`, `createEvent(type, data, clock)` and `isEventOfType(event, type)`. Keep `version()` from Day 01 working and make it return `FORMAT_VERSION`.

Requirements:
- `seq` strictly increases per clock instance
- Clock is injectable, so tests use a fake one

Checks you must run before pushing:
- `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` pass
- Test: 1000 events created in the same millisecond keep increasing `seq`

Implementation commit message: `feat(shared): add event factory, type guard and format version (#2)`

Author every commit as the owner and credit yourself: `git -c user.name="Sergei Kamalian" -c user.email="106472907+SergeiKamalian@users.noreply.github.com" commit --trailer "Co-authored-by: Cursor Agent <cursoragent@cursor.com>" ...`.

If you make a decision a reviewer might question, add an ADR in docs/decisions/ and list it in docs/decisions/README.md.

Push to the existing branch `day-02/session-format`. Do not open a new PR. Do not change earlier parts unless needed to pass checks; say why if you do. Do not do any other part.




---
_G
